newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BioSource begun with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BioSource begun with buy.

text.p: - Pacific Crest Securities initiated coverage of BioSource International Inc with a buy rating, the brokerage said in a brief report.
- Earnings estimates are $0.10 a share for the current quarter, $0.40 for 1996 and $0.56 in 1997, compared with $0.20 a share in 1995.
- The company is a supplier to the biotechnology industry but does not face the risks associated with bringing therapeutic applications to market, the report said.
